name: Walter Staiano
abstract_title: Beyond Fatigue: Using Cognitive Load as Gateway to Peak Experience and Higher Awareness States
abstract: Traditionally viewed as detrimental to performance, mental fatigue and cognitive overload are increasingly being reinterpreted through the lens of adaptive neuroplasticity. In this presentation, I introduce a novel framework positioning cognitive load, especially in the form of deliberate mental fatigue induction through Brain Endurance Training (BET), as a potent catalyst for enhanced conscious experience, including access to flow states and mindfulness-like awareness. Drawing from neuroscience
authors: Walter Staiano, Marco Romagnoli, Ulrich Kirk
affiliation: University of Valencia / University of Southern Denmark
field: Sport neuroscience, cognitive load, mental fatigue, brain endurance training
notable: Leading expert in Brain Endurance Training. Featured in Alex Hutchinson's 'Endure'. Worked with Olympic teams and British Military.
notes: PhD in Psychobiology of Perception of Effort. Over 4000 citations on Google Scholar.
